07fb7dff55beccee612d55954e3f7bd443bc4f97.caption: Accordion group with four closed items "Length", "Drive link gauge", "Saw chain pitch" and "Guide bars", each with a chevron on the right. Only "Length" uses the hint area, showing the value "120cm" as a subtitle below its title, for example to reflect a set filter.

085c8e5281695dd68bdce57e23dcd01f985aaede.caption: Closing animation shown as an open accordion item "Summary of the accordion content" with a chevron pointing up and a Lorem ipsum text block in a highlighted content area, with an arrow leading down to the same item closed with a chevron pointing down. Annotations: the chevron rotates 180°-0° (clockwise), the height of the content area shrinks (100-0%), and the opacity of the content in the content area fades (100-0%).

1325ef3a32874dbd7b6156d32b45ec00ba0ccde6.caption: Filter accordion with four closed items "Category", "Price", "User Groups" and "Area of usage". "Category" shows a grey number indicator "5" and "Area of usage" shows "10", each placed left of the chevron, giving the count of selected filter items; "Price" and "User Groups" show none.

19c92f95e0e6d1be2d1aeab9f5b5db1192f7cd37.caption: Three accordion groups with the size labels medium, small and extra-small, each made of four collapsed items with the summary "Summary of the accordion content", a chevron on the right and divider lines between them. The items get progressively shorter in height from medium over small to extra-small.

1a22d4f3736bed8016eeaf6a06697b38f2dedcf2.caption: Wireframe of three open accordion items, each with a grey header bar and an upward chevron, showing the content area layouts possible inside: the first has one wide purple block, the second two equal blocks side by side, the third three smaller blocks in a row.

246697832fb7cf4482ecf8d8ca9116f40bca8394.caption: Wireframe of a mobile page with a header bar, a headline placeholder, an image placeholder and a list of accordion elements, each with a chevron on the right. Five accordions are closed, the sixth is open with its content area visible, and two more closed accordions follow, so the list is cut off at the bottom of the viewport.

285325ea363f23b31fa086b6ba264c8060f74909.caption: Don't example: filter accordion with items "Category", "Price", "User Groups" and "Area of usage" where "Category" combines the number indicator "5" next to the chevron with the subtitle "Hint with a subtitle". A hint and a number indicator must not be combined, because it overcrowds the component; use only the number indicator for filters.

2d348a65b2d28f25ff3aa8527ea25f1f4767ad2c.caption: Do: a wireframe of a content-heavy page with image and text placeholders and, further down, a small headline above a group of three closed accordions with chevrons on the right, followed by more content blocks. A content-heavy layout should use at least three accordions with a headline above that conveys the group's purpose.

457e184ca1da2fe6d568062836a63f7c0664c517.caption: A STIHL service page for the MS 180 chain saw dimmed behind a "Filter and Sort" drawer on the right with a close button. The drawer holds closed accordions "Length" (with the hint "120cm"), "Drive link gauge", "Saw chain pitch" (with a number indicator "123") and "Guide bars", and at the bottom a filled button "Show results (34)" and an outline button "Clear selection" with an x icon.

4666b0271a6be53b947847b5f8cceb0781bee253.caption: A STIHL web page with a top bar ("Fachhandel finden", icons, "Produktsuche") above a step-by-step guide built from accordions with chevrons on the right. The steps are "01. Bretter zurechtsägen", "02. Teile ölen" (open, with an instruction text and a photo of a man oiling boards on a workbench), "03. Seitenteile zusammenschrauben", "04. Rahmen verschrauben" and "05. Aussteifungen anbringen", with further steps cut off below.

497221909170dae3fa61f6c647372aa332a1567e.caption: A single closed accordion header with the short, plain summary text "Summary of features and fixes" and a downward chevron on the right, as an example of accessible copy without abbreviations.

4ab86c9be9d8cd6568f7129aef0969f139aef4bc.caption: Four closed accordion items labeled "Summary of the accordion content" with chevrons on the right. The second item is in the hover state: the mouse pointer is over it and it has a grey background, while the others are enabled. The annotation reads "fade: background color (color: transparent-hover) opacity (0-100%)".

4c962ad49734dae49f763eb6db2824cad6cc364f.caption: Don't: a red error icon with the message "Some required fields are left empty" is placed directly above a closed accordion titled "Summary of the accordion content". System feedback that relates to content inside the accordion should not be shown above or inside the accordion element.

522f88e99a512241a39402d92730f500baf50f77.caption: A STIHL service page for the MS 180 chain saw dimmed behind a "Filter and Sort" drawer on the right, with closed medium accordions "Sort by" (hint "Relevance"), "Length", "Drive link gauge", "Saw chain pitch", "Guide bars" and "Saw chains", and the buttons "Show results (34)" and "Clear selection" at the bottom. Light purple bands above and below each accordion mark the extra spacing at the top and bottom that gives the click area enough room.

5b06ec092fca473da0d1ac8faf4b5ece941f8b6f.caption: Accordion group with closed items "Smart connector", "Details", "Documents", "My dealer" and "Technical informations". The "Smart connector" header uses the custom hint area with two small icons and text: a device icon followed by "SN: 9834657865" and a Bluetooth icon followed by "Connected", showing at most 2 icons.

608a02a419cbdb256a81d5571a4a236c5bb05457.caption: Opening animation shown as a closed accordion item "Summary of the accordion content" with a chevron pointing down, an arrow leading to the same item opened with a chevron pointing up and a Lorem ipsum text block in a highlighted content area below. Annotations: the chevron rotates 0°-180° (counter-clockwise), the height of the content area expands (0-100%), and the opacity of the content in the content area fades (0-100%).

63d0513bf6bdda182177aae46c27407ce7afe16f.caption: Do: an expandable section in its closed state, with a small triangle icon on the left of the short title "Technical details". This variant of the single accordion puts the icon left of the title and suits an extended content area with a very short title.

6da4493f09893d96f6a21e40648ecc6f85a68ac9.caption: Three accordion headers with chevrons on the right showing recommended formatting. Callout 1: "Text M Bold" title with the regular-weight subtitle "Hint with a subtitle", which gives a clear hierarchy. Callout 2: "Text M Bold long accordion title that breaks in to two lines", bold text limited to a maximum of 2 lines. Callout 3: "Heading L", a short title.

7f2a076be45549535e3d063fd3fe2e09b0e9d39d.caption: Edge case: a yellow warning notification with a warning icon and a close button (ghost, small, icon-only) on the right. The text reads "A new update is required. It includes essential features and fixes. Please update now to continue using the service." Below it is a closed accordion with the left-placed triangle titled "Summary of features and fixes", then the buttons "Update now" (outline, small) and "Update later" (ghost, small). Use accordions in notifications with care, especially for warnings or errors, because the information can be crucial.

81eda12935330bc7c3090f10683ef5d2c435cf3f.caption: Matrix of the single accordion with three columns for Size: medium, Size: small and Size: extra-small and rows for the states enabled, hover (gray background) and focus (dark outline). The rows are grouped by expansion indicator, flush and expanded: right with flush false, right with flush true, left with flush false and left with flush true, each collapsed (expanded: false) and expanded (expanded: true). Every accordion shows the summary "Summary of the accordion content" with a chevron on the right or a caret on the left, and the expanded ones show a purple dashed "Placeholder" content area below the header.

85e8da6b6afae79deaa01b487db9e89f92d2dead.caption: Accordion group of three items where only the first, "01. Teile ölen", is open with an upward chevron, showing German instruction text and a photo of a man oiling a board at a workbench. The other two items, "02. Seitenteile zusammenschrauben" and "03. Rahmen verschrauben", are closed with downward chevrons.

8db08ca9824289884d65a1ed6100fd2a885dcb69.caption: Don't: a wireframe of a text-heavy page with image and text placeholders and only one single accordion row, shown with a small triangle icon and a short bar, between large content blocks. A single accordion in a content-heavy layout is easily overlooked and should be avoided.

8fa75525be539496aedce3c8abaa31e2becfcb84.caption: Wireframe of a SaaS portal with an orange logo area in the top bar, a left navigation, a list of items with small green status squares, and a detail pane. In the detail pane a stack of accordions with chevrons on the right has one open accordion showing a small image and text placeholders, while the others are closed, which keeps the interface uncluttered.

a676328c3c37e8563a93a1034e89599b58eecfaa.caption: Two accordion headers with the title "Title of accordion" and a chevron at the right. In the first, callout 1 points at a purple dashed "Placeholder - Replace this content" element in the hint area, which is the slot for custom elements such as icons, badges and flags. In the second, callout 2 points at the hint "Connected" with a Bluetooth icon.

a689c3eed45f8648e0de280a87ca789e578265b0.caption: Don't: an accordion list with two closed "Summary of the accordion content" rows, then an open accordion "Title of accordion" containing lorem ipsum text and a "Show more" expandable section, followed by two more closed rows. Placing an accordion inside another accordion's content is not allowed.

a773425ff221c19e2478346af2fad67a1c3c60c2.caption: Two sidebar navigations side by side, with a dashed purple outline marking the accordion in each. Under "Accordion expanded" the "Filtered lists" accordion with a count badge of 3 is open and shows "List 1" (selected), "List 2", "List 3" and "Add filtered list" below "Equipment" and above "Connected Hub". Under "Accordion collapsed" only the "Filtered lists" row with badge 3 is shown, followed by "Connected Hub", "Energy Evaluation" and an "Organization" section with "Teams"; both sidebars start with the "Fleet Management" heading.

aa0ac1302d426aaebf0b232c4569fdade6b6a874.caption: Accordion group in the default state with four items, all closed, each showing the text "Summary of the accordion content" and a downward chevron on the right, separated by thin divider lines. More than one item can be open at the same time.

aa7009a894c1e95afdc64939a9150d3ae8eb48a4.caption: Two accordions with four "Accordion summary" items each and a chevron on the right, laid over pink grid columns. Callout 1 points to the narrower one labeled "FIRST QUARTER" (viewports of 1024px and larger, e.g. a filter on a desktop or big tablet), callout 2 points to the wider one labeled "FIRST THIRD" (viewports smaller than 1024px, e.g. a content list on a phone, tablet or split screen).

ad67271be0973d203864dcd802ec82f1f23b4e8a.caption: Don't: a single accordion group stacks three "Accordion Element M" rows, then five smaller "Accordion Element S" rows, then another "Accordion Element M" row, each with a chevron on the right. Mixing medium and small accordions in the same group is wrong.

afda8a4f0b5ccef17fc9b98c38ab6a691e68855d.caption: A single accordion header "Summary of features and fixes Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur." with a chevron on the right. A top measurement labeled "recommenden max text width: font size x 34em" spans from the left edge to the end of the header text, while a bottom measurement labeled "accordion width" spans the full width of the accordion, so the text is much narrower than the accordion.

b1496c9de0adab4f92cc3adb296832a545b11b52.caption: Filter side drawer with the title "Filter" and a close icon, containing flush-aligned accordion items "Length" with the subtitle "120cm - 170cm", "Drive link gauge", "Saw chain pitch" and "Guide Bars", each with a chevron on the right. A dashed vertical line shows that the accordion text starts on the same left edge as the "Filter" title and the buttons below, a filled "Show results (34)" button and an outlined, greyed "Clear selection" button.

b465cdafd642d3098564b60220cd9f3381450962.caption: An accordion group of five collapsed items, each with the summary "Summary of the accordion content" and a chevron on the right, separated by thin divider lines. Callout 1 points at the first accordion item and callout 2 points at the divider border below it.

b674e80a805d58ab35aa12c2f47986ca0148a096.caption: Top: an expanded accordion item with the summary "Summary of the accordion content", the hint "Hint with a subtitle", an up-pointing chevron at the right and a purple dashed "Placeholder" content area; callout 1 marks the header (summary, hint and chevron) and callout 2 marks the content. Middle: the same item with callout a on the summary, b on the hint and c on the expansion indicator, a chevron or caret depending on the use case. Bottom: an expanded item without hint but with the number indicator "123" in a gray pill left of the chevron, marked d.

d1f58190dc77ae8373cb56046704403878fef433.caption: Three accordion headers with chevrons on the right showing formatting to avoid. Callout 1: "Text M Bold" title with the subtitle "Hint with a subtitle" also in bold, which does not guarantee a clear hierarchy. Callout 2: "HEADING M UPPERCASE", uppercase text that is less legible for some users. Callout 3: "Heading lorem ipsum dolor sit amet" in Heading L breaking over two lines, which is too long for that style.

d9c1690f3dda4086b56b5edcad51a248988a155a.caption: Filter accordion with four closed items "Category", "Price", "User Groups" and "Area of usage". Only "Category" shows a small orange dot, the minimized selection indicator, placed left of the chevron. This orange highlight is not recommended and must not be combined with a number indicator in the same section.

de021a8a86f031c28f3556b222125eb684228adb.caption: Don't example: an opened accordion item titled "01. Teile ölen" with a number indicator "1" next to an upward chevron, followed by German instruction text about oiling the parts and a photo of a man oiling a board at a workbench. The number indicator is wrong here because the content is static, descriptive text that cannot be quantified.

e1ef365d1af654c4e771d6f272638f614967e55b.caption: An open medium accordion with a chevron pointing up on the right, a title "Summary of the accordion content" and a hint "Hint with a subtitle". One dark focus outline surrounds the whole header, showing that the header has a single focus and its inner elements are not focusable; a lorem ipsum paragraph is shown below as the content.

e558b0403587d6a761a0ab1b5807cc6e84019026.caption: Accordion group (size medium, flush false, expansion indicator on the right) with four collapsed items, each labeled "Summary of the accordion content" with a downward chevron, placed inside a blue area labeled "NARROW" that marks the content grid narrow. The accordion fills the full width of that narrow grid area, which is its maximum width, for both smaller and bigger viewports.

ef12abd49ee7f24bf2906dd1960274993f1efaa2.caption: Two expanded accordions with the summary "Summary of the accordion content" and a purple dashed "Placeholder" content area. Callout 1 points at an up-pointing chevron on the right of the first header, used when the indicator sits on the right, and callout 2 points at a small down-pointing filled caret on the left of the second header, used when the indicator sits on the left.

f940ce6af502add53076041064976344cc8db942.caption: A closed medium accordion in hover state with a grey background, the title "Summary of the accordion content" and a chevron pointing down on the right. A hand cursor sits over the title, showing that the user has to click or tap actively to change the state.

fb15c0662a261eb179bcb84bb9aee618f2458b01.caption: Don't example: accordion with closed items "Smart Connector", "Details", "Documents", "My Dealer" and "Technical informations" where the custom hint area of "Smart Connector" contains a product photo of a chainsaw and an AK System battery logo. Photos and content images in the hint area are not allowed.

ff138efd20f92a5cebdae7b1a8bff0ba95c743fe.caption: Accordion groups shown in three columns, Medium, Small and Extra-small, with rows for expansion indicator: right with flush: false, expansion indicator: right with flush: true, expansion indicator: left with flush: false and a fourth row labelled expansion indicator: left with flush: false whose items sit slightly further left like the flush variant. Each group stacks seven collapsed items with the summary "Summary of the accordion content", separated by thin divider lines, with a chevron at the right or a caret at the left; the spacing grows from extra-small to medium.
